title: Coherent signed comparisons with every integer shift
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category, $A,B:C\to\mathrm{Ab}$ additive functors and $r:A\Rightarrow B$ natural, and let $F$ be their signed fibre functor [lem-amb-signed-fibre-complex]. Construct coherent natural isomorphisms $F(I[m])\cong F(I)[m]$ for every integer $m$. In degree $n$ the comparison is $(a,b)\mapsto(a,(-1)^m b)$, using canonical transports between equal integer indices. These comparisons satisfy the zero and addition identities of an integer-shift-compatible functor. For $m=1$ the formula is $(a,b)\mapsto(a,-b)$.

source.place: Tags 014E/014F; signed two-term refinement in the proof of lem-amb-signed-fibre-triangulated.

proof.text: Use the sign (-1)^m on the second coordinate and the canonical index transport to construct inverse degreewise maps. Expanding the signed differential proves the chain-map equation: the two signs multiply to one. Diagonal maps commute with the comparisons.

For shift zero, the two transports compose to the identity. For consecutive shifts a,b the transports compose to the single transport and (-1)^(a+b)=(-1)^a(-1)^b; thus the natural comparisons satisfy the CommShift zero and addition identities.
